Name: SpecialBoards
Author: CosmicKillsSouls
Description:
This mod adds the quest boards as farm structures so that you can view all of them without leaving the farm.

Help Wanted Board - [spoiler]Build at Robin after receiving her letter on the 14th of Spring Year 1.[/spoiler]
Special Orders Board - [spoiler]Build at Robin after receiving her letter on the 9th of Fall Year 1.[/spoiler]
Qi's Quest Board - [spoiler]Build at the Wizards shop after receiving the letter from Qi upon finding 120 Golden Walnuts.[/spoiler]






[size=3]Anyone looking to translate the mod should view the source code and make a pull request there or make a separate nexus download of just the i18n translation file.[/size]

Any translations added will be uploaded the same week on Saturday at 10PM EST.
